title: Live Data Viewer
description: Driving dynamics and performance, temperatures, engine health and a fixed dual-DME BM3 channel grid

settings.label: Demo data
settings.default: off

settings.label: Demo driving mode
settings.default: SPORT EXPERT

settings.label: Initial page
settings.default: driving

settings.label: BM3 engine family (confirm exact family)
settings.default: unset

settings.label: BM3 diagnostic ownership
settings.default: Use alone: stop phone BM3, loggers and other diagnostic apps. Temporarily defines F300/F301 with service 2C; no tuning or flash writes. Occupied slots are never overwritten.

settings.label: BM3 availability
settings.default: Exact ROM match required independently per DME. Unproven cylinder-correction array elements and injection-end arrays remain --. DME labels are local ECU slots, not a physical-cylinder map.

settings.label: BM3 refresh
settings.default: Reply-paced grouped reads; getter refresh setting does not apply. Hz measures completed cycles per DME, not display FPS. Stale values expire after 1.5 s. Vehicle speed/accuracy not yet measured.

settings.label: BM3 acquisition details
settings.default: Select an engine family, then open BM3 channels. Forced termination can leave temporary DIDs occupied until ECU diagnostic state resets.

settings.label: Boost source
settings.default: auto

settings.label: Boost updates
settings.default: M Vitals sources; immediate sport-display notifications; 100 ms getter / DME target, not guaranteed

settings.label: Category order
settings.default: driving,temperatures,health,bm3

settings.label: Display
settings.default: Up to 60 FPS; US units; total fuel in US gallons and percent; current battery voltage

settings.label: Fuel percentage
settings.default: Total US gallons / 18 G; display reference, not ECU-reported capacity

settings.label: Sampling
settings.default: Only the visible category collects live readings

settings.label: Pedals
settings.default: 100 ms target on Driving; ECU latency and shared queue limit replies

settings.label: Brake
settings.default: Pressure, not pedal percent; parking brake from Vehicle2

settings.label: Kickdown
settings.default: DME digital switch; never inferred from pedal position

settings.label: Slower readings
settings.default: Fuel 5 s; battery 2 s; TPMS at least 5 s

settings.label: Exhaust controls
settings.default: Manual requests only; highlight is not measured position

settings.label: Temperature models
settings.default: Exhaust and transfer-clutch models are labelled

settings.label: Unsupported readings
settings.default: Front / rear delivered power unknown; no torque-split estimate

settings.label: Min / max
settings.default: This app session only

settings.label: Demo safety
settings.default: Simulated values; exhaust requests disabled

settings.label: Last error
settings.default: None
